pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular polygonal shapes with moderate edge angularity. Pixel gradients at patch boundaries are relatively sharp. Patch area decreases significantly from the mid-flank toward the lower hindquarters, transitioning from large plates to smaller, fragmented clusters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous network of interconnected pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate. Pixel thickness is consistent across the mid-flank but narrows into a denser, more complex web on the lower posterior region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background, showing individual hair-clump pixel spikes.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A significant structural discontinuity is visible where the dorsal line meets a large posterior depression, resulting in a complete break of the linear mane profile.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent, localized region of dark hyper-pigmentation and textural disruption is visible on the upper posterior flank and dorsal ridge, forming a deep, concave morphological depression.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, dark, linear or sickle-shaped indentation is present on the dorsal-lateral interface, representing a major physical trauma or chronic lesion that disrupts the standard pelage topology.
other_distinctive_markers: The localized convergence of dark pigment within the dorsal depression creates a unique high-contrast focal point not mirrored elsewhere in the visible pelage.
